newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG CONFIRM ANELKA TRANSFER TO ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG CONFIRM ANELKA TRANSFER TO ARSENAL.

text.p: Paris St Germain confirmed on Saturday that their young striker Nicolas Anelka had signed for English premier league club Arsenal, adding they had decided not to start a legal battle over the transfer.
"Anelka is an Arsenal player," PSG president Michel Denisot told a press conference before a league match against Guingamp.
The 17-year-old Anelka was in London on Saturday for medical checks. He signed a six-year contract with Arsenal for an undisclosed fee.
PSG initially insisted they would try to stop the transfer, claiming they were entitled to compensation since they had discovered and trained Anelka.
"The two clubs have agreed not to indulge in a long legal battle which none of us was certain to win," Denisot said.
